patch_list: TFD Companion - NGSM validation diagnostics - Troubleshooting purpose
Logs NGSM token-result codes and failed validation values under TFD-NGSM. Does not log tokens or change authentication results.
TFD Companion - Remove illegal apps detection

Removes broad MAIN/VIEW package queries while preserving specific app integrations. For Android 11+. Select only one TFD visibility patch. Leaves NGSM and authentication unchanged; other detections may still occur.
TFD Companion - Remove illegal apps detection (Experimental)
Experimental alternative without a version restriction. Select instead of the regular patch. Requires the original MAIN/VIEW query layout and Android 11+. Future compatibility is not guaranteed.
